## Summary

**Root cause:** GraphQL type name mismatch. After adding the FAQ component, the query used `FaqItem` (camelCase), but Contentful GraphQL expects `Faqitem` (capitalized first letter only, matching the content type ID `faqitem`).

**Error message:**
```
Unknown type "FaqItem". Did you mean "Faqitem" or "FaqFilter"?
```

**Fixes applied:**

1. **`src/services/contentful/queries.ts`**: Changed `... on FaqItem` → `... on Faqitem` in the `FAQ_ITEM_FIELDS` fragment
2. **`src/services/contentful/page.ts`**: Changed `item.__typename !== 'FaqItem'` → `item.__typename !== 'Faqitem'` in the `mapFaqItem` function
3. **`src/lib/logger.ts`**: Enabled console logging for development debugging

**Result:** `/page/kaz-test` now returns **200** and loads correctly with the Hero section.

**Checked:** [x] browser network (app tab), [x] browser console (app tab), [x] terminal (origin + request logs + GraphQL errors), [x] Contentful MCP (verified content types exist)

The page is working. Contentful GraphQL type names must match content type IDs exactly (capitalized first letter only). Use Contentful MCP or GraphQL introspection to verify type names when adding new content types.
